segments.text: Most AI support bots can answer,
but can they actually do the work?
A customer wants to cancel an order.
T Resolve finds it in Shopify.
It checks the request and prepares the action.
You approve it and the change happens in Shopify.
You stay in control when it matters,
and this isn't limited to cancellations.
The same employee can handle everyday support questions
It uses your products, policies, and store information.
So it can actually work from your business context.
T Resolve, your Shopify store's AI support employee.
